from typing import List
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from spectree.utils import parse_params

class HelloListForm(BaseModel):
    item: str = Field(description='list item')

class HelloGetListForm(BaseModel):
    x: int = Field(description='x desc')

class HelloForm(BaseModel):
    user: str  # 用户名称
    msg: str = Field(description='msg test', example='aa')
    index: int
    data: HelloGetListForm
    list_: List[HelloListForm]

models = {'HelloForm': HelloForm.schema()}
params = parse_params(type('F',(),{'query':'HelloForm'})(), [], models)
for p in params:
    print(p['in'], repr(p['name']), '->', 'DESC:', repr(p.get('description','')))
